title: Experience
subtitle: Over ten years across AI engineering, embedded systems, and enterprise architecture.

items.title: AI Engineer / Tech Leader / Solution Architect
items.description: Full responsibility for technical direction and solution design of complex microservices ecosystems integrating advanced AI technologies. Key technical reference for AI integration within process automation, leading multiple successful AI Proofs of Concept. Engineer cost-effective, custom-built RAG data pipelines from scratch to outperform expensive off-the-shelf solutions. Led an international 20-person Java development team in a high-pressure client environment and currently lead 6-person Python teams on projects from scratch to production. Enforce rigorous testing standards (Pytest, JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, Sonarqube) and manage application health via Mirantis, Freelens, and Splunk.

items.title: Software Engineer
items.description: Coordinated a 4-person development team on Progetto Atlante, a specialized research project funded by the Tuscany Region (POR FESR 2014-2020) in partnership with CNR-INO and the University of Florence — delivering a remote structural vibration monitoring prototype with sub-micrometric sensitivity via infrared digital holography. Engineered GUI and CLI seismic data analysis applications in Python on the ObsPy framework for client-facing delivery. Programmed microcontrollers in C and C++ for integrated seismic and structural monitoring systems, handling power management and ADC/GPS data acquisition. Developed standalone electronics initiatives including an intelligent solar-panel battery charger for boats and a GPS base station.

items.title: Software Engineer
items.description: Designed and developed robust application software for an ARM-based touchscreen diagnostic device — the Soft FX Skin Analyzer, today commercially shipped to aesthetic clinics worldwide. Built the UI and core logic in C++, Qt, and QML, integrated OpenCV and GStreamer for image processing pipelines, and shipped a custom Embedded Linux distribution tailored to the device hardware using the Yocto Project. Prototyped physical device enclosures with 3D printing to accelerate hardware iteration.

items.title: Software / Automation Engineer
items.description: Configured hardware and developed software for Siemens and Allen-Bradley PLCs and industrial Fanuc robots (Fanuc-certified). Executed testing, fine-tuning, and commissioning of automation lines directly at client sites — taking direct field responsibility from electrical schematic review through acceptance.

items.title: Full Stack Software Developer
items.description: Contributed to a Java/JavaScript web-based management system for workplace safety, integrating with SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle DB.
